Phase.FormWaiting: {name}: the next form has no token on this scene. Select one and use “Bind selected token” in the hub, “On the scene”.

Hud.Setup: Set up a Boss Bars profile

Unsaved.Title: Unsaved changes
Unsaved.Body: Close the window and discard the changes?

Profile.Title: Boss Bars profile

PlayerName.Label: Name for players
PlayerName.Hint: Leave empty to show the token's name (or the actor's, one per actor). Change it to reveal the enemy.

Portrait.Label: Portrait
Portrait.Hint: Image, GIF, WebP or a webm video. Empty: the actor's image.

Focus.Hint: Which part of the picture the round frame shows: the centre point moves to the middle of the frame, the zoom brings it closer. 50 / 50 / 100: the whole picture, centred.

DisplayMode.Label: Display
DisplayMode.Hint: One per actor sums the HP of all its tokens on the scene and shows their number.

Rank.Label: Rank
Rank.Hint: The rank decides which parts the card shows and where it stands in the column.

Remove.Title: Remove the profile
Remove.Body: The actor stops being a boss or elite, and its bars and cards are hidden on every scene. Remove the profile?

Profile.LookHint: The look and overrides are saved with the profile. A preset is edited in the look library.
Profile.EliteLook: An elite wears the look of its rank: set it in "Elite ranks".

Ranks.Title: Elite ranks
Ranks.Hint: Strongest first. A rank sets which parts an elite card shows, its colour and icon size.
Ranks.Name: Rank name
Ranks.RemoveBody: {count} actor(s) have this rank. They will get the rank "{fallback}". Remove the rank?

Panel.Empty: No tokens with a Boss Bars profile on this scene.
Panel.FormWaiting: The form waits for a token.
Panel.NoSelection: Select one token on this scene first.

Music.Hint: The boss's music: when the first boss with music is shown, whatever plays fades out and resumes after the fight from where it stopped. Only the scene the players stand on counts.
Music.SourceHint: A track, or a whole playlist played in its own mode. Volume comes from the track.
Music.PriorityHint: With several bosses the highest priority plays; then the larger bar, then the one shown first.
Music.FadeHint: How long the music fades out and in.

Quotes.Hint: Lines the boss says over its bar; everyone sees them. Crit and miss work only when the attacker targeted the boss before rolling.
Quotes.Texts: One line per variant; {name} is the boss's name, {attacker} the attacker (crit and miss only)
Quotes.Limits: Up to 30 quotes, 10 variants of 200 characters each.

Phases.Hint: Up to 6 phases. The first is the start of the fight; later ones begin below an HP threshold, as a form (the bar moves onto another actor's token) or by hand from the hub, “On the scene”. Thresholds only go forward.
Phases.Scale: HP scale with the phase thresholds
Phases.Label: Phase label
Phases.FirstPlaceholder: Label (empty: none for the first phase)
Phases.Limits: Up to 6 phases; thresholds 5–95%, at least 8% apart.

FillMode.Label: Fill with phases
FillMode.Segments: Segments: the bar is all HP, ticks at thresholds
FillMode.Refill: Refill: the bar is the HP of the current phase
FillMode.Hint: Matters only for a boss with HP thresholds.

PlayerTicks.Label: Ticks for players
PlayerTicks.Hint: Players see the threshold ticks on the bar. The GM always does.

Error.NoRanks: There must be at least one rank.
Error.TooManyRanks: There can be at most 20 ranks.
Error.RankName: A rank needs a name of at most 40 characters.
Error.RankSize: The icon size must be between 24 and 64 px.
Error.NotGM: Only a GM can change the boss bars.
Error.NoGM: No GM is online: showing and hiding wait for a GM.
Error.NotActiveGM: This GM is not the active GM.
Error.Invalid: The request or the stored data is invalid.
Error.NewerData: This data was saved by a newer Boss Bars 5e version and is left unchanged.
Error.NoProfile: This token's actor has no Boss Bars profile.
Error.NoInstance: No such boss bar or elite card is shown.
Error.NoToken: This actor has no token on the scene.
Error.NoSuchPhase: This boss has no such phase.
Error.NoQuote: This boss has no such quote.
Error.NoCounter: This profile has no such counter.
Error.NoSuchStatus: This boss has no such custom status.
Error.WriteFailed: The boss bars could not be changed. See the console.
Error.WindowFailed: The Boss Bars 5e window could not be loaded. See the console.
Error.FieldPath: A path starts with system. and has only letters, digits, _ and dots.
Error.BarMax: The maximum must be a positive number or a system. path (a counter: 1 to 9999).
Error.StatusName: A status needs a name of at most 40 characters.
Error.DelayRange: The delay must be between 0 and 60 seconds.
Error.ImportTooLarge: The file is larger than 256 KB.
Error.ImportInvalid: This is not a Boss Bars 5e library file.
Error.ImportEmpty: The file holds no looks or presets.
Error.ThresholdRange: A threshold must be between 5 and 95%.
Error.ThresholdGap: Thresholds fall from phase to phase and keep at least 8% apart (a form starts over).
Error.NoFormActor: Choose the actor of the form.
Error.QuoteTexts: At most 10 lines of at most 200 characters.
Error.PercentRange: The share must be a whole number from 1 to 99%.
Error.NoPhase: Choose one of this boss's phases.
Error.NoStatus: Write a status id or an effect name.
Error.CooldownRange: The cooldown must be 0 to 99 rounds.
Error.DurationRange: The time must be empty (automatic) or 1 to 20 seconds.
Error.PriorityRange: The priority must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
Error.FadeRange: The transition must be 0 to 10 seconds.

Layout.Title: Layout
Layout.Hint: Drag the blocks on your screen: they stick to the centre and edges and anchor to the nearest of 9 points. Arrows move the selected block by 1 px (Shift: 10 px), Escape leaves. Players see the changes after you save.

MiniBars.Hint: Up to 6 small bars under the boss bar or inside the elite card (when its rank shows the fill). Players never see numbers.
MiniBars.Label: Label

Statuses.Hint: Icons come from the effects shown on the token. Midi QOL bookkeeping and DAE duplicates are never shown.
Statuses.CustomHint: Switched on per boss in the hub, “On the scene”.
Statuses.Name: Name

AutoShow.Hint: The active GM shows and hides this enemy by itself.
AutoShow.DelayHint: Before hiding. Healed in time, a defeated enemy stays shown.

SettingsFile.Confirm: Replace this world's elite ranks, own looks and presets, and screen layout with the ones in the file? Profiles on actors are not touched.
SettingsFile.Imported: Boss Bars settings imported: elite ranks, own looks and layout.
SettingsFile.Invalid: This is not a Boss Bars 5e settings file, or it is damaged. Nothing was changed.

Library.Title: Looks and presets
Library.Hint: Built-in looks and presets, and the world's own: copy, edit, import and export.
Library.Name: Name
Library.ReadOnly: Built-in: read only. Make a copy to edit it.
Library.ColorsHint: Up to 5 colours, #rrggbb, separated by commas.
Library.RemoveUsed: “{name}” is used by {count} own look(s); they will take Classic RPG for this category. Delete?
Library.Imported: Imported: {looks} look(s), {presets} preset(s). Save to keep them.

Param.TrailAccumulate: Trail builds up in a series
Param.PhaseBanner: Phase change: banner with the phase name

Hub.Title: Boss Bars
Hub.PickProfile: Pick a profile on the left, drop an actor from the sidebar, or select a token and press "Selected token".
Hub.NoToken: Select a token on the scene first.
Hub.DropHint: Drop an actor here to set up its profile.
Hub.WorldActorsOnly: Only actors of this world can have a profile.
